notes: SoothToken (src/SoothToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin 5.4.0 ERC20 and ERC20Permit. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 SOOTH (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory. There is no mint function, minter role, owner, pause, blocklist, freeze, seize, burnFrom or upgrade path, so the supply can never grow and nobody but a holder or a spender they approved can move a balance. Transfers carry no fee, burn or reflection, so every launch flow (factory to distributor, distributor to claimants, factory to pool, pool to traders) moves exactly the amount requested; no launch address needs exempting, so the constructor takes none of $factory, $poolManager or $launchNumber. ERC-2612 permit lets a holder set their own allowance by signature and grants no privilege to anyone else. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD at 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60; initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (4,000 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply. Of the supply, 80% seeds the pool single-sided and the requester's remainder goes to 0x206f5dbf4f135c6183b5a5b99327fa0be34cb4d9.
